label: heroes
description: Scarlet Vale hero run cycle (run2), 8 frames
original_prompt:
Generate a sprite sheet of 1 hero character "Scarlet Vale" for the hand-painted circus game Petal Panic, continuing the exact same hand-painted circus style as the prior Scarlet Vale sheets above.

LAYOUT: 1 row x 8 columns on a solid uniform pink background (rgb 252,151,170). The single row is the Scarlet Vale heroine; the 8 columns are her 8 run animation frames shown left-to-right. All cells exactly the same size (~222x442 px), evenly spaced, separated by thin light-pink grid lines (rgb 255,210,220, 2px wide). No text, no labels, no dark borders between cells. Image 1774 wide x 442 tall.

STYLE: hand-painted circus / storybook illustration, soft painterly brushwork with visible texture, warm saturated palette (crimson red, deep black, cream skin tones, white feather accent). A glamorous burlesque/circus heroine: long flowing wavy black hair, a large crimson rose tucked into her hair, a black domino mask over her eyes, a white-and-grey plume/feather headdress arcing up behind her head. She wears a red bra-style top, a short red skirt, thigh-high black stockings, and red high-heeled shoes, with a flowing red cape/sash trailing behind. Full-body side profile facing right, dynamic and elegant. Consistent style across every frame.

ROW (left to right), 8 distinct loopable run-cycle frames:
1. STRIDE - right leg extended forward, left leg pushing back, arms mid-swing, cape billowing.
2. CONTACT - legs passing through neutral, body slightly compressed, weight transferring.
3. PUSH - left leg driving forward, right leg trailing, torso leaning into the run.
4. RECOVER - opposite stride mirroring frame 1, arms swinging the other way.
5. STRIDE 2 - right leg forward again, hair and cape at peak flow.
6. CONTACT 2 - legs crossing through neutral, cape settling.
7. PUSH 2 - left leg driving, momentum building.
8. RECOVER 2 - returning toward frame 1 pose so the loop closes smoothly.

Frames within the row must be clearly distinct but smoothly sequential (loopable). Keep it clean and croppable.
